name: hardware_sensors
desc: 读取硬件传感器节点(温度/电流/电压)
cmd: f="$filter"; for d in /sys/class/power_supply/*; do echo "== $d =="; for f in $d/voltage_now $d/current_now $d/capacity $d/temp; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo -n "$(basename $f)=" && cat $f 2>/dev/null; done; done 2>/dev/null | grep -i -- "${f:-.}" | head -${lines:-60}
